versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of robot-task-protocol (v1.0.0).
- Enables dispatching paid tasks to physical robots via the Spraay x402 gateway with escrow-protected payment.
- Supports workflows for both buyers (find, hire, pay robots; task status) and operators (register, update, report task completion, deregister robots).
- All requests routed exclusively to user-configured SPRAAY_GATEWAY_URL; no external data sharing.
- Includes safety and payment handling guidelines, and detailed usage instructions with cURL examples.
- Registration and operation as a robot operator are free; buyers pay per-request micropayments via x402.

- Initial release of "robot-task-protocol" skill to dispatch paid tasks to physical robots via the Spraay x402 gateway using the Robot Task Protocol (RTP).
- Includes workflows for buyers (finding robots, viewing profiles, dispatching tasks with escrow-protected payments, polling status) and operators (registering, updating, and deregistering robots, reporting task completions for payment).
- Paid endpoints require per-use micropayments via x402 HTTP payment protocol; registration and management endpoints are free.
- Emphasizes confirming task details and payment with users before dispatching, as commands control real hardware.
- Provides detailed setup, endpoint use, and error handling instructions.
